div.div:
GAP (Aaron's v2 thesis): visual design intent has no Forge artifact yet.
UI/UX intent currently lives in figma/ slack/ docs/ — outside the taxonomy.
Until it's modeled, the harness can't validate shipped UI vs intent.

div.div:
How dependencies enforce value-proof:
NFRs reference ADRs + UTs → traceability link from constraint to who's affected.
Specs reference Stories → executable proof that the thing built matches what was asked for.
LayerTypes reference ADRs → codifies that infra changes flow from arch decisions.
